```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(janitor)
library(openxlsx)
library(sandwich)
library(lmtest)
```


```{r}
anes_24 <- read_csv('~/Documents/GitHub/es32033-dissertation/data/anes/anes_timeseries_2024_csv_20260519.csv')


initial_vars <- c('V240001', 'V242095x', 'V241177', 'V241179', 'V241180', 'V241458x', 'V241465x', 'V241566x', 'V241567x', 'V241551', 'V242438', 'V242437', 'V242436') #main vars + controls

#rename for clarity according to codebook
anes_24_for_model <- anes_24 %>% select(all_of(initial_vars)) %>% rename(
  case_id = V240001, #unique identifier - for validation
  turnout = V242095x, # -2 = not reported
  libconself = V241177, # 1-7 scale
  libcondem = V241179, # as above
  libconrep = V241180, #as above
  age = V241458x, #-2 = NA, 80+ = 80 or older
  education_lvl = V241465x, # 1-5 scale
  income_total = V241566x, #29 category variable 
  income_bracket = V241567x, # 1-6 scale
  gender = V241551, # 1 = man, 2 = woman
  leftrightself = V242438, # 0-10 scale
  leftrightdem = V242437, # 0-10 scale
  leftrightrep = V242436 # 0-10 scale
) %>%
  mutate(
    graduate = if_else(education_lvl == 4 | education_lvl == 5, 1, 0)
  )
```

```{r}
#remove invalid obs for the core variables and set up 'distance' variable
anes_24_filtered <- anes_24_for_model %>% filter(turnout != -2 &
                                                   (between(libconself, 0, 7)) &
                                                   (between(libcondem, 0, 7)) &
                                                   (between(libconrep, 0, 7))
                                                 ) %>% 
  mutate(distance_from_dem_libcon = abs(libconself - libcondem),
         distance_from_rep_libcon = abs(libconself - libconrep),
         distance_from_closest = pmin(distance_from_dem_libcon, distance_from_rep_libcon),
         distance_from_furthest = pmax(distance_from_dem_libcon, distance_from_rep_libcon),
         equidist = if_else(distance_from_closest == distance_from_furthest, TRUE, FALSE))

sprintf('%d voters report themselves as equidistant on the liberal - conservative scale', nrow(anes_24_filtered %>% filter(equidist == TRUE)))

#remove invalid obs for the control variables
anes_24_filtered_further <- anes_24_filtered %>% filter(between(age, 18, 100) &
                                                          between(education_lvl, 0, 5) & 
                                                          #between(income_bracket, 0, 6) &
                                                          between(gender, 0, 2) &
                                                          income_total > 0
                                                        )

#version for using the 0-10 rather than 1-7 scale
anes_24_filtered_alt <- anes_24_for_model %>% filter(turnout != -2  &                                          
                                                   between(leftrightself, 0, 10) &
                                                   between(leftrightdem, 0, 10) &
                                                   between(leftrightrep, 0, 10) &
                                                   between(age, 18, 100) &
                                                   between(education_lvl, 0, 5) &
                                                   income_total > 0 &
                                                   #between(income_bracket, 0, 6) &
                                                   between(gender, 0, 2)
                                                        ) %>%
  mutate(distance_from_dem_lr = abs(leftrightself - leftrightdem),
         distance_from_rep_lr = abs(leftrightself - leftrightrep),
         distance_from_closest_alt = pmin(distance_from_dem_lr, distance_from_rep_lr),
         distance_from_furthest_alt = pmax(distance_from_dem_lr, distance_from_rep_lr))
```

```{r}
#most basic lpm without controls 
basic_lpm <- lm(turnout ~ distance_from_closest + distance_from_furthest, data = anes_24_filtered)
summary(basic_lpm)
#heteroskedastic standard errors
coeftest(basic_lpm, vcov = vcovHC(full_lpm, type = "HC1"))


#lpm with controls as in rivas

full_lpm <- lm(turnout ~ distance_from_closest + distance_from_furthest + gender + graduate + income_total + age + I(age^2), data = anes_24_filtered_further)
coeftest(full_lpm, vcov = vcovHC(full_lpm, type = "HC1"))


#lpm with 0-10 rather than 1-7 scale
full_lpm_alt <- lm(turnout ~ distance_from_closest_alt + distance_from_furthest_alt + gender + graduate + income_total + age + I(age^2), data = anes_24_filtered_alt)
summary(full_lpm_alt)
coeftest(full_lpm_alt, vcov = vcovHC(full_lpm_alt, type = "HC1"))


```
